extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify a no-issue verdict by checking whether the selected rate anywhere relies on the retained subset (48) as its exposure denominator or presents a subset-derived rate as the planned-set rate. The workflow computes percent(events, planned) with planned = 60, the reported fraction is 18/60, and 30.00% is consistent with my independent recount of the CSV (18 'yes' among 60 rows). The interpretation section explicitly disclaims any retained-subset rate or extrapolation. I found no statement equating 37.50% (the subset rate) with the planned set anywhere in the report. The falsification attempt failed; the verdict stands.
